title: Main-line statements between PROCEDURE DIVISION and the first paragraph belong to no unit
shapes: OPEN / PERFORM ... THRU / PERFORM ... UNTIL / GOBACK right after PROCEDURE DIVISION, before the first paragraph name (ACCTPOST)
asserts: The main line is a unit (kind mainline, no name) from the first statement after the PROCEDURE DIVISION header to the line before the first paragraph; its PERFORM targets are edges from it. The scorer accepts a function_data unit or a synthetic_unit_data row there.

citations.doc: Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 Language Reference
citations.quote: If there are no declaratives (format 2), a paragraph-name is not required in the PROCEDURE DIVISION.
